events.verdict: Brooks (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in Sochan's (SAS) path and the two players briefly engage and disengage.
Johnson (SAS) steps into Green's (HOU) path and trips him, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Both Smith Jr. (HOU) and Eason (HOU) legally contest Johnson's (SAS) driving shot attempt.
Branham (SAS) firms up in a screening position in Green's (HOU) path with his arms collapsed against his own body. There is marginal leg contact as Green attempts to move around the screen.
Paul (SAS) steps forward into Smith Jr.'s (HOU) body and causes him to lose his balance.
Green (HOU) contests the jump shot attempt by Branham (SAS) and avoids making any illegal contact.
Green (HOU) moves his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.

Eason (HOU) steps into Paul's (SAS) landing area and Paul lands on his foot upon returning to the floor. After communicating with the Replay Center, officials determine that the play meets the criteria for a flagrant foul penalty 1.

Green (HOU) clamps and holds Sochan's (SAS) right arm, affecting his ability to pursue the rebound. There is no illegal contact by Sochan and therefore, the foul should have been called on Green instead.
